belief: I look carefully before I decide what is true.
title: True Clue Detective Sort
subtitle: See clearly like Ganesha and sort the details that truly help you decide.

content.instruction: Read each clue card. Sort it into TRUE CLUE if it proves something, or DISTRACTING DETAIL if it only grabs attention.
content.category_right_hint: Details that look loud but do not prove it

items.label: Wet footprints lead from the juice box.
The open window is beside the spill.
The cat is sleeping in the corner.
A straw lies next to the puddle.
Someone drew stars on the wall.
The napkin is soaked where the spill began.
A toy dinosaur is on the shelf.

content.footer: Point to the strongest TRUE CLUE before you make your guess.

generation.answer_rule: Only details that help you decide what is true belong in TRUE CLUE.

wisdom.statement: I look carefully before I decide what is true.
wisdom.today: Before you guess today, look for one clue that really proves it.
